1.$description: Charts in the admin console (dark only, like the desk). Validated with the dataviz skill's validate_palette.js against the window glass (#151515): - Categorical, fixed order, never cycled: all six in L 0.48 to 0.67, 3:1 or more on the glass, worst adjacent CVD delta E 8.4, normal vision 19.3. "Other" and context series are muted. - Ordinal (funnel steps, light to dark): monotone, adjacent delta L 0.06 or more, the dark end 2.25:1 on the glass (values are labelled in text beside each bar). - Sequential (retention grid, low to high): text on bins 0 to 3 is white (5.4:1 or more), on bins 4 and 5 ink (7.1:1 or more); every cell prints its value.

$description: Liquid, dark scheme. Solid content under a floating glass layer: translucent bars, sheets, menus and controls with blur, saturation, a light edge and a soft shadow; one tint picked up by glass at low strength; capsule controls; springs. Values Liquid does not set keep the Neutral value of the same scheme (accents, states, charts, canvas). Proposed, Liquid.

spring-soft.$description: The soft spring (stiffness 400, damping 40) as a linear() curve: no overshoot, about 375ms. Sheets, panels, fades that travel. Proposed, Liquid.

spring-snappy.$description: The snappy spring (stiffness 600, damping 39): a 2% overshoot, about 300ms. Controls that answer a press. Proposed, Liquid.

spring-bouncy.$description: The bouncy spring (stiffness 340, damping 22): about 10% overshoot, about 500ms. A thumb, a lens or a toast that lands. Proposed, Liquid.

stiffness.$description: Soft spring, no overshoot. Proposed, Liquid.
Snappy spring, a 2% overshoot. Proposed, Liquid.
Bouncy spring, about 10% overshoot. Proposed, Liquid.
